crossRefs.note: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter…
Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and…
Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make…
I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all…
The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for…
toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them…
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in…
‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today…
‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of…

translations.web: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture; for they have gone into captivity from you!
translations.bsb: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children; make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
translations.kjv: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity
translations.asv: Make thee bald, and cut off thy hair for the children of thy delight: enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
